1._note: Verify exact ckpt filename in models/checkpoints

inputs.ckpt_name: ltx-2.3-22b-distilled.safetensors (or your installed LTX-2.x distilled checkpoint)

10._note: For video output, replace with your VHS_VideoCombine node (VideoHelperSuite).

2._note: Face-visible held pose from the event folder. Sunset silhouettes will fail identity; pick a face-visible frame.

3._note: Your trained Cezar LoRA. Strength 0.8-0.9; lower if the face drifts, raise if identity is weak.

4._note: Positive prompt. Keep 'same man as reference' phrasing; identity comes from the LoRA + reference image, not the words.

inputs.text: man in black shorts holding a handstand on wet sand at sunset, ocean behind, held pose, photorealistic, same man as reference, natural skin texture

5._note: Negative prompt. No color work, ever.

inputs.text: color grading, oversaturated, cartoon, extra limbs, invented gymnastics, blurry face, watermark

6._note: 9:16 portrait. 97 frames @24fps ~4s per take; takes are cut to shot durations in assembly. denoise <1.0 preserves reference structure.

7._note: Distilled schedule: 8 steps per the official distilled i2v recipe.

8._note: cfg 2.5 per the distilled recipe. If any LTXV output slot differs in your build, rewire: conditioning in, latent in, samples out.

_meta.base: Start from the official ComfyUI-LTXVideo example workflow 'IC-LoRA distilled model depth + human pose + edges', then apply the node values below.
_meta.format: ComfyUI API format. Paste into ComfyUI via 'Load' or POST to /prompt.
_meta.node_sources: LTXV* nodes are ComfyUI core (comfy_extras.nodes_lt) or the official Lightricks ComfyUI-LTXVideo pack. If a node name differs in your install, map it in the UI; the wiring and parameters are what matter.
_meta.purpose: Single held-pose image-to-video with the Cezar LoRA. Passes only if the identity gate passes: spot-check output against the 6-frame identity sheet. Do not proceed to event takes until this passes.
_meta.title: CEZAR-A identity proof (Mac proof run)

gate: IDENTITY GATE: compare output frames against the 6-frame identity sheet (output/roughcut/spotcheck_identity.png). His eye decides. Failures are discarded, never fixed in post.
